title: Potential and Challenges of Model Editing for Social Debiasing
findings: Model editing techniques can effectively mitigate religious biases. The SERAC method achieved 100% success on in-domain edits for religion. Furthermore, the paper found that debiasing effects can generalize across different bias types; for instance, editing for religious bias showed some debiasing effect on professional bias, and vice-versa, with success rates typically between 20-38% for cross-type generalization.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the effectiveness of model editing techniques in mitigating stereotypical biases related to religion. This is done by evaluating whether an edited model assigns a higher likelihood to an unbiased sentence compared to its stereotypical counterpart, based on data from the StereoSet benchmark.
